predecessors.name: Maya city-states (Preclassic and Classic)
predecessors.text: Yaxchilan on the south bank of the Usumacinta 'at the apex of a horseshoe-shaped meander'

ledger.x: 23 July 359: 'The known history of Yaxchilan starts with the enthronement of Yopaat B'alam I, most likely on 23 July 359.'
About 790: 'Yaxchilan's king Shield Jaguar III oversaw the installation of Chan Muwaan II in Bonampak', making Bonampak a dependency.
808: page silent on Bonampak after about 790; the pairing ends with the last Yaxchilan monument (Lintel 10, 808).
808: 'Lintel 10 is the last known monument at Yaxchilan, dating to 808'; in the same year K'inich Tatb'u Skull III captured Piedras Negras's Ruler 7.

wars.name: Yaxchilan-Piedras Negras wars
wars.outcome: 460 Moon Skull's victory over Piedras Negras; about 478 Bird Jaguar II captured a vassal of its king; 514 Knot-eye Jaguar I captured by Ruler C; 726 Yaxchilan defeated by Piedras Negras (Stela 8; 727 on that page); 759 Yaxchilan 'gaining a victory over its…

wars.name: Yaxchilan's captures of Lacanha lords
wars.outcome: 'Knot-eye Jaguar II is known to have captured the lord of Lacanha in 564' and 'In 729, Itzamnaaj B'alam II captured Aj Popol Chay, the lord of Lacanha'.
